page_title: SAL 0-2 FIO | Salernitana v Fiorentina 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' 0 - 2 Goal! Rolando Mandragora passes the ball to the feet of Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:2.
90+4' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Guillermo Ochoa pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
90+4' 1:5 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
90+1' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for an infringement.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner.
87' We are about to witness a substitution. Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) is replacing Antonin Barak.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Toma Basic as he is replaced by Simy (Salernitana).
84' Here comes a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) is brought on as a substitute for Junior Sambia.
82' Here is a change. Alfred Duncan is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).
82' That's the end of the game for Michael Kayode, who is replaced by Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina).

80' 0 - 1 The ball hits the back of the net! Luca Ranieri showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it into the top left corner – 0:1.
77' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

76' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Guillermo Ochoa leaps like a salmon to deny him.
75' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matteo Marchetti no option but to blow his whistle.
73' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
71' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch for Maxime Lopez.
70' Substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) replaces Gaetano Castrovilli.
68' Stefano Colantuono has decided to make a change. Shon Weissman (Salernitana) replaces Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi.
68' Substitution. Antonio Candreva is replaced by Agustin Martegani (Salernitana).
66' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' The ratio of the ball possession is 25:75.
63' Lorenzo Pirola is substituted due to injury. Stefano Colantuono gives a chance to Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana).
62' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) picks up an injury.
61' Fiorentina decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
61' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) will miss the next game.
61' Yellow card. Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
60' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
58' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
58' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Salernitana out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
55' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
54' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
51' Salernitana failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, Salernitana are awarded a corner kick.
50' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) heads on.
47' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Salernitana, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
47' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marchetti had an easy-decision to make.
46' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Guillermo Ochoa.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Matteo Marchetti has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Toma Basic (Salernitana) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
45' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
43' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
42' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post.
41' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
41' One of the Salernitana players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
38' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

38' Toma Basic (Salernitana) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Pietro Terracciano shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
37' Salernitana have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' Rough tackle by Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 0:2.
27' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' The Fiorentina players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' Gaetano Castrovilli (Fiorentina) is caught offside!
21' The possession of the ball – 29:71.
20' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle. Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
18' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
13' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
10' One of the players from Salernitana times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
8' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guillermo Ochoa, who smothers the ball.
4' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
2' Great teamplay by Fiorentina as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Salernitana will have the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti is introduced as the referee for today's match.
